name: com.scribase/scribase
title: Scribase
description: Backend for your app: Postgres, auth, storage, functions. Create projects, run SQL, branch, deploy.

tools.name: projects_list
tools.description: List your projects with their branches and status. Start here to find project ids. Scope: projects:read.

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page

organization_id.description: Organization id, e.g. `acme`. Default: the token's.

tools.name: projects_create
tools.description: Create a backend (Postgres, Auth, Storage, Realtime, Functions) and wait until it is live. All arguments are optional. Returns the project URL and publishable key for createClient(). A 402 confirm_billable answer means it adds to the bill: ask the user, then call again with confirm_billable_cents. Scope: projects:write.

confirm_billable_cents.description: The monthly_delta_cents of the 402 confirm_billable answer, once the user approved the charge, e.g. 500. Never guess it.

engine.description: Database engine. Default: the deployment's. `postgres-cow` has instant branches; `neon-cloud` scales to zero.

name.description: Project name, e.g. `todo-app` (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens). Optional.

organization_id.description: Organization id, e.g. `acme`. Default: the token's.

region.description: Region id. Optional; hosted Scribase runs in `eu-frankfurt`.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait until live (default 60; 0 returns at once)

tools.name: keys_get
tools.description: The project URL and publishable (anon) key for supabase-js, as .env lines. The secret (server-only) key is included only with include_secret: true and the keys:secret scope; it bypasses row level security and must never reach client code. Scope: keys:read.

include_secret.description: Also return the secret key (needs keys:secret)

organization_id.description: Organization id, e.g. `acme`. Default: the token's.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. `todo-app`. Default: the last one used, or your only one.

tools.name: projects_start
tools.description: Start a real backend with no account and no bearer token: a temporary project (deleted after about 72h unless claimed). Returns connection details, an agent token to use as the bearer for every other tool, and a claim_url. Show the person the `keep.hint` line at once: only a person can claim the project (sign up, same URL and keys). With a bearer token, use projects_create instead.

name.description: Project name, e.g. `todo-app` (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens). Optional.

tools.name: sql_execute
tools.description: Run SQL on a branch as the project's database role. Read-only by default; pass read_only: false to write (database:write). DROP, TRUNCATE and DELETE/UPDATE without WHERE need confirm: true and the destructive scope (production:destructive on production). Use migrations_apply for schema changes. On production without production:destructive, a confirmed destructive call is not run: if the project has a production approver it is stored, that person is emailed, and the reply is status approval_required with an approval_id. Wait with approvals_wait; do not send it again. Scope: database:read.

confirm.description: true only after the user approved the destructive operation

organization_id.description: Organization id, e.g. `acme`. Default: the token's.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. `todo-app`. Default: the last one used, or your only one.

query.description: SQL, e.g. `select * from todos limit 10`. One statement when read-only; a script in one transaction when writing.

read_only.description: Default true. Set false to write (needs database:write).

tools.name: migrations_apply
tools.description: Record and apply one migration (name + SQL) in a single transaction, then reload the REST API's schema cache. It is linted first: a table without row level security is blocked. dry_run: true only lints. Destructive SQL needs confirm: true and the destructive scope (production:destructive on production). On production without production:destructive, a confirmed destructive migration waits for the project's production approver: the reply is status approval_required with an approval_id; wait with approvals_wait. Scope: database:write.

confirm.description: true only after the user approved the destructive operation

dry_run.description: Only lint and plan; change nothing

organization_id.description: Organization id, e.g. `acme`. Default: the token's.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. `todo-app`. Default: the last one used, or your only one.

version.description: Version number; default is the current UTC time as YYYYMMDDHHMMSS

tools.name: tables_list
tools.description: Tables on a branch with row counts, and whether row level security is on. Scope: database:read.

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page

organization_id.description: Organization id, e.g. `acme`. Default: the token's.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. `todo-app`. Default: the last one used, or your only one.

tools.name: tables_describe
tools.description: Columns, primary key, foreign keys, indexes, row level security and policies of one table. Scope: database:read.

organization_id.description: Organization id, e.g. `acme`. Default: the token's.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. `todo-app`. Default: the last one used, or your only one.

tools.name: types_generate
tools.description: The supabase-js `Database` TypeScript type for a branch's schema. Save it as database.types.ts and use createClient<Database>(url, key). Scope: database:read.

organization_id.description: Organization id, e.g. `acme`. Default: the token's.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. `todo-app`. Default: the last one used, or your only one.

tools.name: functions_deploy
tools.description: Create or replace an edge function (Deno, TypeScript). Pass `source` for a single file, or `files` (path -> source) with an `entrypoint`. It is served at <project URL>/functions/v1/<name>. Scope: functions:write.

organization_id.description: Organization id, e.g. `acme`. Default: the token's.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. `todo-app`. Default: the last one used, or your only one.

verify_jwt.description: Require a valid JWT to call it (default true)

tools.name: storage_buckets_list
tools.description: Storage buckets on a branch. Scope: storage:read.

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page

organization_id.description: Organization id, e.g. `acme`. Default: the token's.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. `todo-app`. Default: the last one used, or your only one.

tools.name: auth_config_get
tools.description: Auth settings (site URL, redirect allow list, JWT expiry, sign-up rules) and providers. Scope: auth:read.

organization_id.description: Organization id, e.g. `acme`. Default: the token's.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. `todo-app`. Default: the last one used, or your only one.

tools.name: logs_get
tools.description: Recent log lines for a branch, newest first: auth, rest, storage, realtime, functions or gateway. Scope: logs:read.

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page

organization_id.description: Organization id, e.g. `acme`. Default: the token's.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. `todo-app`. Default: the last one used, or your only one.

search.description: Case-insensitive text to find in messages

since_ms.description: Only lines at or after this epoch-millisecond time

tools.name: branches_list
tools.description: Branches of a project with kind, status, parent and expiry. Production is protected. Scope: branches:read.

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page

organization_id.description: Organization id, e.g. `acme`. Default: the token's.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. `todo-app`. Default: the last one used, or your only one.

tools.name: branches_create
tools.description: Fork a branch from production (or `from`) for one task, agent or pull request: a copy-on-write database with its own URL and keys. Expires after ttl_hours. Returns its URL and publishable key once live. Scope: branches:write.

data.description: What to copy from the parent (default snapshot: schema and data, copy-on-write)

from_time.description: Optional RFC 3339 time, e.g. 2026-09-28T10:15:00Z: the branch holds its parent as it was then (inside the project's history window, shown on the Branches page)

organization_id.description: Organization id, e.g. `acme`. Default: the token's.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. `todo-app`. Default: the last one used, or your only one.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait until live (default 60; 0 returns at once)

tools.name: branches_merge
tools.description: Merge a branch's schema changes into its parent (default production). Without apply it is a dry run that shows the plan and conflicts; apply: true with confirm: true applies it. Scope: branches:write.

apply.description: Apply the merge (default false: plan only)

confirm.description: true only after the user approved the destructive operation

organization_id.description: Organization id, e.g. `acme`. Default: the token's.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. `todo-app`. Default: the last one used, or your only one.

tools.name: approvals_wait
tools.description: Wait for the project's production approver to decide a request that came back with status approval_required. Holds up to wait_seconds, then returns state: pending (call again with the same approval_id), executed (approved and run exactly as sent; result is the response the original call would have had, continue), failed (approved but the request did not succeed), denied or expired (refused: it did not run, do not retry it). Never send the original call again while one is pending. wait_seconds: 0 just reads the state. Scope: projects:read.

approval_id.description: The apr_… id from the approval_required reply

organization_id.description: Organization id, e.g. `acme`. Default: the token's.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. `todo-app`. Default: the last one used, or your only one.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to hold for a decision (default 45; 0 returns at once)

tools.name: docs_search
tools.description: Search Scribase docs: how to connect an app, row level security, branching, migrations, functions, storage, auth, tokens. Returns short answers with links.

query.description: The question, e.g. `how do I add Google sign-in`

tools.name: auth_users
tools.description: List auth users via the per-environment GoTrue admin API. GET .../auth/users.

organization_id.description: Organization id (letters, digits, hyphens), e.g. `acme`. projects_list shows it.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. `todo-app`. projects_list shows it.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Find Scribase tools that are not listed here, by task or by toolset (database, schema, schedules, services, branches, observability, mobile, platform, org, backups, import). Returns names, descriptions and input schemas; run one with call_tool. No arguments lists the toolsets.

query.description: What you want to do, in plain words, e.g. `run a cron job every night`. Optional.

toolset.description: List every tool of one toolset, e.g. `schedules`. Optional.

tools.name: call_tool
tools.description: Run any Scribase tool by name, including ones search_tools found that are not listed here. Same scopes, confirmations and limits as calling the tool directly.

arguments.description: The tool's arguments, per its input schema, e.g. {"name": "nightly", "schedule": "0 3 * * *", "sql": "select 1"}.

name.description: Tool name as search_tools returned it, e.g. `schedule_create`.
